temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals and sleep; he invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated to his hospital work but is overworking to the point that his health and well-being may suffer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's refusal confirms that he is heavily consumed by hospital obligations and feels unable to step away, despite Ethan's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is serious and tied to hospital demands; he is not currently willing or able to take a restorative break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary take a break or find another way to protect his health, despite Gary's initial refusal.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work; when Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is mainly due to hospital demands, though he remains concerned about Gary's health and reluctance to rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's restlessness and evasion make Ethan suspect there is a deeper, more complicated problem beyond professional obligations, and that Gary is hiding it to avoid burdening others.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork likely stems from personal or emotional struggles as well as work, and Gary is reluctant to open up but may need support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and encourage him to share his problems, offering nonjudgmental help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges; he agrees that he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork has deeper causes beyond routine hospital duties, and that Gary has been hiding personal or professional stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's disclosure confirms Ethan's suspicions and reveals the specific sources: new departmental pressures and personal challenges. Gary is also willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by real work pressures and personal struggles, and Gary is open to working with Ethan to find a healthier balance.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief mixed with empathy; compassionate and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule for better work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Gary reports progress and remaining challenges: he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie. Ethan tells Gary he is proud and remains available to talk.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has acknowledged the need for balance and agreed to work on it, but may still struggle with ongoing pressures and challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reports over time confirm that he is making real progress, benefiting from support, and gradually reducing his overwhelm.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is improving toward a healthier balance and is still working through challenges, but he is no longer as overwhelmed and can benefit from continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in with Gary, offering support and encouragement while he maintains his progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and appears capable of managing on his own. Gary thanks Ethan, saying he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has made meaningful progress but may still need some ongoing support to maintain a healthy balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's sustained adjustment and expression of control confirm that he has achieved a stable, healthier balance and can manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of managing on his own; Ethan's active intervention is no longer needed, though Ethan remains willing to help if called upon.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently while remaining available if Gary ever needs support.
